notes:
### Added
- **Field prefixes in card search.** One box now answers "which Charizard, from
  which set?" — `charizard set:evolving-skies year:2021 215` works in the Search
  tab, the scan card picker and a set's own filter. `name:`, `set:`, `year:`
  (single or `1999-2002`), `lang:` (`en`/`ja`/`zh` plus `jp`/`cn` aliases) and
  `number:` (`#215` shorthand) are ANDed; plain words keep today's name/set/number
  matching. `set:` ignores punctuation, so `team-rocket` finds Team Rocket, and an
  unknown prefix like `foo:bar` stays free text.
- A `Fields` button beside the search box opens a syntax cheat sheet, and parsed
  terms appear as chips underneath (`set: Evolving Skies`, `2021`, `Japanese`,
  `#215`). A malformed field (`year:abc`, `lang:xx`) is shown as an error chip and
  ignored as a filter instead of silently emptying the list.
- `src/lib/searchQuery.ts` owns the grammar and `cardSearch.ts` gains the single
  `entryMatches`/`filterEntries` pair every surface shares, replacing the two
  hand-rolled predicates in `CardPicker` and `SetDetail`.
- Set names and years are passed per query rather than baked into the cached
  index, so the post-paint `useSets()` overlay cannot stale it, and plain-word
  matching gains a set-name path it previously lacked. `number:` still tries an
  exact match before falling back to a substring. No Dexie schema change and no
  scan-index rebuild.
